children: Dynamix reported net income for the quarter, compared with a year-earlier loss. Higher dividends from investments held in the trust account and interest income more than offset increased general and administrative expenses; the company said it has not begun operations and generates no operating revenue.
: Dividends earned on investments held in the Trust Account were $1.9M, compared with none in the year-earlier quarter.
: General and administrative expenses rose to $658,376 from $47,771, including $120,000 for administrative support services.
: The company continued identifying a target for its initial Business Combination; it said there is no assurance it will complete one within the Completion Window.
: Cash and cash equivalents outside the Trust Account were $692,013 at September 30, 2026; $538,724 was withdrawn from the Trust Account for working capital during the nine months.
